title: Need help for pixel art pipeline
author: The_Montone
selftext:
Good day, everyone. I’ve run into a challenge in my pipeline: I’m looking for a way to create character sprites inspired by the video game \*Eiyuden Chronicle\*, without relying on paid online services. I have access to Stable Diffusion Neo Forge, but the results haven’t been great—I’m struggling with consistency and animation issues. I also tried using Blender to address the consistency problem, but the prototype models just aren’t working for me.

Up until now, I’ve been describing my requirements to ChatGPT, which would then provide a prompt for me to paste into Claude. To avoid wasting any more tokens, how can I go about generating high-quality pixel art in the style of "Eiyuden Chronicle"?

comments.author: Entropydemic
comments.body: Give your image generator a pair of reference images and then convert that to video. I'll just make one for the purpose of this post.

replies.author: Entropydemic
replies.body:
So i just took a dragon girl from an ad for OOC Chat bot and the Eiyuden chronicles model and bashed it. Now I'll convert to video...

https://i.redd.it/oylpx6sxur1i1.jpeg

replies.author: Entropydemic
replies.body:
Then after making the video, cut it into the parts you do or don't want, and form it into a sprite sheet with Aseprite or whatever sprite tool you have, to cut away the background, like white in her case. And bam, you have a sprite sheet. Aseprite can convert right from GIF or MPG too.

https://i.redd.it/hdt0fotfxr1i1.gif

replies.author: Entropydemic
replies.body:
Now that you have a sheet, you can set up other neat tricks, like...

https://i.redd.it/50gwoxmpzr1i1.jpeg

replies.author: Entropydemic
replies.body:
...going back into your image generator to make up tweaks like, she has on futuristic armor or a space suit or something.

https://i.redd.it/asa7exoxzr1i1.jpeg
